maddeler.e:
افتحلت (form VIII)
# اِفْتَحَلْتُ (iftaḥaltu) /if.ta.ħal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# اِفْتَحَلْتَ (iftaḥalta) /if.ta.ħal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# اِفْتَحَلْتِ (iftaḥalti) /if.ta.ħal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# اِفْتَحَلَتْ (iftaḥalat) /if.ta.ħa.lat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
